complaint.title: Complaint
complaint.description: Represents a single complaint submitted by a user.

email.description: Email of the user submitting the complaint.

description.description: A detailed description of the complaint.

category.description: The category of the complaint (e.g., Road Maintenance, Waste Management).

priority.description: The priority level of the complaint (e.g., Low, Medium, High).

location.description: GPS coordinates of the incident location.

imageUrls.description: An array of URLs for attached images.

status.description: The current status of the complaint.

timestamp.description: The server timestamp when the complaint was submitted.

reportedBy.description: The UID of the user who reported the issue.

assignedTo.description: The UID of the authority member assigned to this complaint.

frequency.description: How often the issue occurs (e.g., recurring, one-time).

/users/{userId}.description: Stores user profile information, including their role.
